title: Microsoft 365 Backup: activity logs for policy and restore operations
summary: The briefing passes: its navigation, commands, roles, pricing and retention statements are supported by Microsoft documentation. It correctly distinguishes the operational logs from Purview Audit, flags the beta API and reports the different roadmap and tenant-notice schedules.

claims.claim: Purview audit-record retention depends on the licence assigned to the users whose activity is audited.

claims.claim: Purview retains records for 180 days for other non-E5 Office 365 or Microsoft 365 users without the specified premium add-ons.
claims.quote: For users assigned any other (non-E5) Office 365 or Microsoft 365 license, the system retains audit records for 180 days.
